title: Iridescent Masquerade Mask
description: A realistic Venetian-style full-face mask centered against a dark gradient background. The mask features a metallic grey base with abstract splotches of purple, blue, and gold, accented by dripping paint effects, musical notes, and geometric patterns. The eye openings and lip line are trimmed in reflective gold.
prompt: A highly detailed Venetian masquerade mask with a metallic grey surface covered in abstract watercolor-like splotches of purple, violet, and blue. Gold leaf accents line the eyes and lips. Subtle musical notation and geometric fragments float across the surface with dripping paint effects. The mask is centered, evenly lit with soft highlights, against a smooth dark gradient studio background.
